notes:
What's new in 0.1.81:
• More security fixes from our own reviews. Details are kept private.
• Organizer can send files to a network drive (NAS) with a safety check; the original is kept if anything fails.
• Space Saver (Beta): a backup counts only when the computer holds an identical copy.
• Large buttons, high-contrast choices and a captions default.
• Daily screen time counts the repeated hour when the clocks go back.
• Photo copies drop one more hidden block that could carry location details.
• Live TV recordings with reserved Windows names get a safe file name.
• Plain sentences instead of error codes on many screens, in six languages.
• Household Library and Channel Surfer are labelled In development.
• The updater checks free disk space and warns before installing while Beebo is busy.
• The installer is not code-signed.
• Built from commit 2768a3a01, Oct 7, 2026, 2:01 AM Eastern.
